name: Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling
description: A regenerating enchanted undershirt that resists several disruptive combat effects.

name: Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness
description: A cloak that adds 4 Constitution and provides poison, ice, and anti-piercing protection.

name: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk
description: A toe ring that adds 3 Strength and improves Powerful Strike.

name: Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces
description: Spiked kneepads that reflect 10% of damage and cancel momentum-based attacks.

name: Goblin Copper Chopper
description: A goblin-built chopper used for traversal and battlefield construction.

name: Enchanted War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull
description: A wrist brace that transforms into a spiked war gauntlet when Carl makes a fist, adding 1 Dexterity and 3 Strength in fist mode.

name: Silver Adventurer Box
description: Awarded for the Early Adopter achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

name: Bronze Adventurer Box
description: Awarded for the Empty Pockets achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

name: Gold Apparel Box
description: Awarded for the Why Aren't You Wearing Pants? achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

name: Bronze Weapon Box
description: Awarded for the Unarmed Combat achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

name: Goo-Inator 3000
description: A shaping tool that can be used at a workbench.

name: Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph
description: A limited-use kit that adds 15% bare-foot attack damage, makes Carl's feet unbreakable, and warns of foot-triggered traps five seconds before activation.

name: Enchanted BigBoi Boxers
description: Enchanted boxers that add 2 Constitution and grant the Protective Shell spell.

name: Proximity Trigger
description: A Sapper's-table component that can be attached to a non-static trap.

name: Carl's Jug O' Boom
description: Carl's stackable incendiary dungeon invention.

name: Big Top Ticket
description: A ticket acquired after defeating Terror the Clown during the circus ambush.

name: Mongo's Tracking Collar
description: A magical tracking collar for Mongo received by Donut from a Gold Pet Box.

name: Fang Caps
description: Magical caps fitted onto Mongo's fangs to modify bite attacks.

name: Pharmaceutical Starter Kit
description: A starter kit obtained from Quint in trade for moonshine.

name: Blitz Sticks
description: Combat stimulant consumables traded from Quint.

name: Hoblobber
description: A launcher purchased from Pustule on the Silk Road.

name: Hobgoblin Dynamite
description: High-yield explosives purchased from Pustule.

name: Xistera
description: A Cesta Punta scoop weapon unlocked from Fan Boxes.

name: Kimaris Figure
description: A decorative figure looted by Carl.

name: Sheol Glass Reaper Case
description: A specialized containment case capable of encapsulating active Soul Crystals.

name: Carl's Doomsday Scenario
description: Carl's hazardous invention created by encapsulating an exploding Soul Crystal inside a Sheol Glass Reaper Case.

name: Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore
description: A legendary crown worn by Donut before its destruction by a precursor magical shock.

name: Magical Pet Carrier
description: A magical carrier capable of teleporting pets into containment and rest states.

name: Enchanted Anklet of the Fallen Oak
description: An enchanted anklet looted by Donut from Grace Bautista's corpse.

name: Earth Hobby Potion
description: An Earth hobby potion that grants a random Earth skill upon consumption.

name: Louis L'Amour Paperbacks
description: A collection of Louis L'Amour Western paperbacks awarded by the AI.

name: Home Depot Cactus
description: A potted cactus awarded as an Earth hobby reward.

name: Large Cat Tree
description: A large carpeted cat tree awarded to Donut.

name: Scented Candle
description: A scented candle awarded to Donut.

name: Framed Picture of Beatrice
description: A framed photograph of Beatrice and Brad received from a Fan Box.

name: Skill Potion: Acute Ears
description: A skill potion that grants or improves the Acute Ears skill.

name: Scroll of Upgrade
description: A magical scroll used to upgrade an equipped item.

name: 100,000-Gold Casino Chip
description: A high-value casino chip received from a Lucky Bastard box.

name: Parasite-Laced Ice Cream Cone
description: An ice cream cone containing parasitic worms from Apollon the Mighty.

name: Lottery Scratchcard Ticket
description: A lottery ticket capable of producing high-tier magic effects or unexpected outcomes like custard.
